title.zh: 何时需要更复杂的程序结构？

summary.en: Change one demonstration and certify when the shortest legal solution grows from one rule to two. Follow the consequences across displayed tasks, hidden witnesses and new inputs.
summary.zh: 改变一个展示样例，认证最短合法解何时从一条规则变成两条，再比较题面、隐藏见证与新输入上的模型表现。

scope.en: The certificates apply to a bounded string-replacement language. Witness gains coexist with low agreement on new inputs that activate both rules.
scope.zh: 证书适用于有界字符串替换语言。隐藏见证成功率上升的同时，模型在实际触发两条规则的新输入上一致率仍然很低。

summary.en: When a model proposes a set of passages, is it worth measuring that set once before returning it? The study compares that check with choosing the best context already measured.
summary.zh: 模型推算出一组候选段落后，值得再测一次吗？研究将这种核验与直接采用已测最优上下文作对照。

scope.en: The offline score requires a reference answer. Against the best measured nine-call baseline, the paired 95% interval for the change in answer F1 includes zero.
scope.zh: 离线评分需要参考答案。与九次测量下的已测最优策略相比，答案 F1 差值的配对 95% 区间包含零。

summary.en: A refusal score can rank two prompts correctly and still misclassify the safe one. PAIRSAFE follows both decisions across 150 matched pairs, comparing scores, held-out thresholds and generated responses.
summary.zh: 拒答分数可以把两个提示排对，却仍然误拒良性一侧。PAIRSAFE 沿着 150 对匹配样本，分别检查分数排序、留出阈值和实际生成。

scope.en: The generation check covers Qwen and uses archived rule-based labels. The release reproduces the main table from scores and identifies the final nested metadata audit as a transcription from the paper.
scope.zh: 生成检查只覆盖 Qwen，采用归档的规则标签。发布包可从逐例分数复算主表，并标出了定稿嵌套元数据审计的转录来源。

title.zh: 用配对自助法评估小幅改进

summary.en: A paired bootstrap protocol for evaluating small reported improvements.
summary.zh: 用配对自助法评估小幅提升，研究对象是常见的微小性能差异。

summary.en: Audit-guided trust control in surrogate-assisted evolutionary hyperparameter optimization.
summary.zh: 研究如何在代理辅助的进化式超参数优化中，利用审计反馈调整信任程度。

title.en: From Evidence Scores to RAG Answers: Budget, Search, and Presentation
title.zh: 从证据评分到 RAG 回答：预算、搜索与呈现

summary.en: Two selection paths separate passage budget, combination search and presentation order. A saved answer at each step shows where an apparent gain originates.
summary.zh: 沿两条配对路径，分别改变段落预算、组合搜索和呈现顺序。每一步都有已保存的回答，可以追查最终得分从哪里来。

scope.en: Six passages, short-answer multi-hop QA and one global reversal define the experiment. Reference-answer likelihood is an offline selection objective.
scope.zh: 实验覆盖六段候选、短答案多跳问答和一次整体反序。使用参考答案计算的似然属于离线选择目标。

title.en: Beyond Pairwise Overlap: Shared-Value Observations for Compositional Text Embeddings
title.zh: 超越两两重叠：组合文本嵌入的共享值观测

summary.en: Two sets of 23 observations see the same pairwise overlap pattern. Following the identity of the shared city changes how well they reconstruct a held-out directory.
summary.zh: 两种方案各观察 23 个状态，编辑之间的两两重叠图相同。追踪重叠处是否指向同一座城市，会改变未见名录的嵌入重建误差。

scope.en: The study concerns a finite synthetic directory and fixed encoders. Qwen uses a preselected subset of the original test pool.
scope.zh: 结论来自有限的合成名录和固定编码器。Qwen 实验使用原测试池中预先选定的子集。

title.en: When Does Document Replay Help Evidence-State Question Answering?
title.zh: 文档回放何时有助于证据状态问答？

summary.en: Adapters replay the same questions with or without supporting documents. Switching the unrelated attachment at test time reverses which specialist leads.
summary.zh: 两组适配器复习相同的问题与答案，一组带文档，一组闭卷。测试时更换一份与问题无关的附件，两组的领先顺序随之翻转。

scope.en: The evaluation uses a single 1.7B backbone, synthetic inventory worlds and multiple-choice readouts. The mixed continuation matches updates and supervised answers while reading different token counts.
scope.zh: 评估使用一个 1.7B 基座、合成库存世界和选项式读出。混合续训对齐了更新次数与监督答案数，各分支读取的 token 数仍有差别。
